*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

 However, automated text-reuse analysis via DharmaNexus indicates substantial intra-Pali formulaic sharing, recording 39 matching passages across 14 Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. The recurring verses—particularly concentrated in segments §4–§7—show substantial overlap with other apadāna narratives, most extensively with the *Ekavihārikattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 433, segments §5.1–7.1), the *Vibhītakamiñjiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 443), the *Avaṭaphaladāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 383), and the *Ārakkhadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 313) [DharmaNexus]. Parallel formulaic segments are likewise shared with the *Sumedhātherīapadāna* (Thi-Ap 1) and the commentary to the *Theragāthā* (*Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*) [DharmaNexus].
